changes.rationale: The candidate consumes a clap 4.6 grammar instead of a handwritten token parser. Clap errors are mapped to stable sanitized identities without rendering or retaining untrusted input.
One static descriptor catalog supplies the exact ten groups, nested routes, options, purposes, and effects; the clap builder, help renderer, catalog API, and parity tests all consume it.

Command descriptors use crate::context::EffectClass directly. Read routes remain Read; local artifact and apply routes are WorkspaceWrite; export, publish, and provider adapters are ExternalWrite; migrate retire is Destructive.
--json is the sole machine-mode selector. Help, version, and error documents carry fixed schema identities and valid isolated JSON; error output never includes clap's raw diagnostic text.

Arguments are byte/count bounded, singleton options reject duplication, paths reject traversal and alternate escape encodings, identifiers are bounded ASCII, and effect overrides or undeclared write verbs fail closed.
The module parses and describes only. It constructs no LiveContext, dispatches no command, reads no repository or environment state, emits no telemetry, and makes no behavior or readiness decision.
